name: likewize/faq-accordion
title: FAQ Accordion
description: Collapsible FAQ section with questions and answers

default.question: When does my coverage start?
default.answer: Coverage begins immediately upon enrollment if the device is new. For existing devices, a 30-day waiting period may apply before you can file a claim for accidental damage.

default.question: What information do I need to file a claim?
default.answer: You will need your mobile number, the device serial number (IMEI), brand and model, and a valid payment method for the deductible.

default.question: Can I go to an Apple Store for repairs?
default.answer: Yes! We are an authorized partner. Once your claim is approved, you can choose to take your device to any authorized repair center, including Apple Genius Bars or Best Buy Geek Squad.
